question: What maximum QQ gateway message size may the bundled client enforce without rejecting supported platform events?
rationale: The external QQ contract is not demonstrated, and the chosen threshold directly controls whether existing message delivery remains compatible.

options.title: Use the QQ contract
options.body: Set the limit from an official QQ gateway size guarantee and add boundary and reconnect coverage.

options.title: Approve an observed ceiling
options.body: Adopt a larger owner-approved limit backed by captured production event sizes and explicit safety headroom.

options.title: Retain the ws default
options.body: Do not lower the 100 MiB library default until the platform contract and recovery behavior are known.

recommendation.title: Use the QQ contract
recommendation.body: Set the limit from an official QQ gateway size guarantee and add boundary and reconnect coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work owns the current QQBot gateway architecture and provides the strongest available history signal for this compatibility choice.
